biggest_catch: Kellogg's lab pays at checkout — genuinely same-day — but its official rate is only an 'up to' ceiling ($21-28/hour in-lab), not a concrete payout floor, so the required numeric payout minimum cannot be set.
catches: Official rate is 'up to $21-28/hour' in-lab — a ceiling, no floor; actual pay per study is variable.
Online studies pay up to $16/hour, virtual up to $17-21/hour.
In-lab studies require the Chicagoland area (Evanston or Chicago downtown campus).
Studies run 10-60 minutes; many in-lab studies take about 30 minutes.

c1.evidence: Official participant FAQ confirms payment at checkout: 'A research assistant will check you out and provide compensation for your time.' Compensation may be cash, VISA pre-paid card, or electronic Tango Card.
